can_act_on_github.description: Rubato can post as this person, so *Accept plan* works (ADR 0030).

cannot_act_reason.description:
Why not, when it cannot: `no_token_key`, `oauth_only`, `tokens_do_not_expire` or
`log_in_again`.

operator.description: Listed in `RUBATO_OPERATORS`: may use the operator page (ADR 0088).

tenants.description: The tenants this person is a member of, with their role in each (ADR 0087).

voice.description: A plan room's voice channel (ADR 0073); absent while `RUBATO_VOICE` is off.

Role.description:
A member's role in one tenant (ADR 0088). An operator is not a role: it comes from the
server's configuration, never from a tenant.

oneOf.description: Invites, changes roles, removes members, and creates, edits and deletes workspaces.

TenantInfo.description: One tenant the person is a member of, as `Me` lists it.

VoiceAvailability.description: Whether voice is on for this server, on `Me` only while it is (ADR 0073).

enabled.description: A voice channel can be joined: LiveKit is configured.

speech.description: A speech provider is configured: utterances reach the room and spoken replies play.

speech_hosts.description: The provider's hosts, for the consent text; empty for the fake adapter.
